variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

variants.name: M1001 Flechette
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a M1001 40mm high velocity canister cartridge filled with a ton of flechette darts!
Highly effective against body armor and enemies behind cover!

variants.name: Exotic Slugs
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to an exotic 12 gauge slug housed in an adapter!
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head.

variants.name: M576 Buckshot
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a M576 40mm Buckshot shell, firing 20 destructive pellets from your grenade launcher!
Lower velocity but larger overall damage.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 40mm Sponge
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a 40mm Sponge Grenade, a large projectile produced to disable or confuse a single target (for riot control).
Powerful and able to down an opponent instantly at any range but suffers from extremely low muzzle velocity!

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: 410 Beehive
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 bore housed in a four slotted hornet's nest shell (16 pellets).
Less power and ammo, but more range, speed, and pellets per shot.
